services.name: Fort Lauderdale Parasailing Flight
services.desc: Each Flight is 8-12 minutes depending on weather conditions. The total duration of excursion is dependent on number of guest on board (1.5 -2 hours) About 2 or 3 people can fly at the same time. Some restrictions apply depending on weight and wind conditions; ultimately it’s the Captain’s decision. The minimum combined weight is 130lbs and maximum combined weight about 450-600 lbs. Weight requirements change daily due to wind conditions and are subject to Captain’s approval. Add a photo Ages 5+

services.name: Private Parasailing Tour
services.desc: Enjoy a Private Parasailing Tour! About Bring up to 12 people and have the boat all to yourselves for the hour! This is the perfect option if you would like to have longer flight times and a more private experience. 1-3 people can fly at the same time. Some restrictions apply depending on weight and wind conditions; ultimately it’s the Captain’s decision. The minimum combined weight is 130lbs and maximum combined weight about 450-550 lbs. Weight requirements change daily due to wind conditions and are subject to Captain’s approval. Add a photo Ages 5+

includes: High quality digital Photo or GoPro Package for download
gap: Price amounts for public and private flights not stated
blurb: Guests parasail over Fort Lauderdale Beach, flying up to 3 people at once on public flights or up to 12 on private tours. Flights last 8-10 minutes within excursions of approximately 90 minutes for public and 120 minutes for private tours. The boat departs from a location near the corner of Los Olas and Sea Breeze Blvd, one block from the beach.

quotes.author: Tracey TIllman • Trip Advisor
quotes.text: This was my first time Parasailing and I can’t swim so I was scared. But it was absolutely amazing. Not scary at all. The driver and photographer were great. I felt safe and secure. You have the option of staying dry or dipping in the ocean. Take the dip! It was so fun .. when your in the sky it’s so quiet and surprisingly peaceful. I recommend for adults and kids.

quotes.author: Nathan W. • Google Reviews
quotes.text: [I've] lived in the area my whole life and never seen it from this perspective! Would rate it 10 out of 10 for anybody looking for a fresh breath of air in these times. The captain and crew made us feel extremely safe and it was obvious they knew exactly what they were doing.

quotes.author: Cody W. • Google Reviews
quotes.text: The crew was fun, I felt absolutely safe throughout the entirety of the flight, and it was an overall fantastic experience. The highlight of my trip. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to get a beautiful view of the water and the Lahaina coastline.

quotes.author: Olka G. • Facebook
quotes.text: We had so much fun! We saw the parachute in the air from the shore and decided to give it a try! It was our first time and we loved it! It’s affordable and so fun! Definitely recommended! The crew was amazing and we felt safe and secure!
